_comment: Bind this object to the 'Base Config' property on each grid instance. Remove keys you don't want standardized. Use 'Base Config Excludes' on a specific grid to opt out of individual keys.
_comment_height: height: any CSS length (e.g. '500px', '80vh', '100%') — only used when layout is 'fixed'
_comment_cellAlignment: cellAlignment: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' — only used when cellAlignmentMode is 'custom'
_comment_dataSource: dataSource: 'mapping' | 'supabase'. When 'supabase', the full table (up to 15,000 rows) is loaded once on mount; AG Grid then handles all filter/sort/scroll in-memory.
_comment_viewConfiguration: viewConfiguration: object — bind to a variable, e.g. variables['UUID']?.['config']. Structure: { sizes: {colId: width}, filters: {}, sorting: [{colId, sort}], columnsOrder: [colId], hiddenColumns: [colId] }. Empty values are ignored.
_comment_viewEditedVariableId: viewEditedVariableId: UUID string of a WeWeb boolean variable — set to true when grid state differs from viewConfiguration, false when they match
_comment_columnChooserVariableId: columnChooserVariableId: UUID string of a WeWeb boolean variable — controls the column chooser visibility (toggle show/hide)
_comment_focusedRowId: focusedRowId: string | null — ID of the row to highlight and scroll into view (must match idFormula output). Example: globalContext.pageParameters['id']. Set to null or '' to clear.
_comment_textColor: All color properties accept any CSS color value (hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, named colors, 'transparent')
_comment_headerFontSize: Font size properties accept any CSS length (e.g. '13px', '0.8rem')
_comment_headerFontFamily: Font family properties accept any CSS font-family value
_comment_headerHeight: headerHeight: number (pixels) — only used when headerHeightMode is 'fixed'
_comment_actionBorder: actionBorder: any CSS border shorthand value
